32676b0.summary: Returns true if any trait currently showing on this entity matches the given trait (LINQ Any over CurrentShowingTraits). The decompiler output is mostly generic Linq boilerplate repeated several times; it has no side effects.
comments: Closure captures the trait so the Any() predicate can compare each CardTraitData against it
Source list is CurrentShowingTraits (traits visible on the card, not hidden ones)
Linq.Any argument checks: null list or null predicate throws ArgumentNull
Inlined interface lookup: finds the IEnumerable implementation of the list and gets an enumerator
Enumerate the traits; stop at the first one for which the predicate returns true
Calls the predicate (trait == requested trait) on the current element
Exception unwind / finally: the enumerator is disposed after the loop; result is whether a match was found
From here on the decompiler duplicated the Any() code for other generic instantiations; it is not game logic
Tail is unrelated generic Enumerable.Append code merged in by the decompiler; ignore it

comments: Closure holds the wanted trait for the Find predicate
Find the first current trait entry whose trait equals the requested one
Found: return its stored value; the decompiler lost the else branch, which returns 0 when nothing matched

3267878.summary: Returns the CardTraitData in CurrentTraits matching the given trait. If the card does not have the trait, returns a new hidden placeholder with trait none so callers never get null.
comments: Find the first current trait entry matching the requested trait
Not found: build an empty hidden placeholder entry (trait none) as a null-safe default

32649a4.summary: Adds up the melee or ranged attack changes from this entity's active extrinsic addStats effects. Returns the total for the requested attack type.
comments: Null check on the active effects list
Walk every active effect on this entity
Only extrinsic stat buffs (applied from outside, e.g. auras or enchantments) count
Pick the ranged or melee change field depending on attack type; any other type adds nothing

3264ff0.summary: Returns the card's current value for a trait plus the values of all active addTrait effects for that trait, never below zero. Used when abilities compare numbered traits like bastion.
comments: Result is unused here (decompiler artifact of a GetTrait call)
Sum the value of every active addTrait effect that grants this trait
Base current trait value plus granted amounts
Clamp negative totals to 0 (branchless max with 0)

3267bb8.summary: Coroutine for the fatigue card animation when a player draws from an empty deck. It scales the card in at the deck, tweens it to the shown position with a flip, waits, then scales it to zero.
comments: State 2 is the final state; any other state is handled below
State 1: the first wait is over, so shrink the card away and wait a final time
Scale the card down to zero
Wait for the card's creationTime before the coroutine finishes (state becomes 2)
State 0: first step. Any other state means the coroutine is done
Start the card at 1% scale so it can grow in
Move the card to the deck position
Show the fatigue damage number on the card
Set the card back sprite and hide the front side while it is still face down
Scale up to a start size, then bounce to full size after the creation delay
Move from the deck to the shown position with a bounce
First half of the flip: rotate to 180 degrees (0x42b40000) and call FinishCardDrawRotation when done
Second half of the flip: rotate back to 0 after the first half finishes
Wait for creation delay + draw time + show time, then continue in state 1
A null reference somewhere above ends here
Coroutine finished: state is set to -1 and false is returned

3267af0.summary: Switches the fatigue card between its front (image, description, damage text) and back (card back). Front elements get frontSide; the card back gets the opposite.
comments: Each element is null-checked then toggled with SetActive(frontSide)
Card back is shown when the front is hidden; the SetActive call itself was lost by the decompiler

comments: Both null counts as equal; otherwise compares the Unity objects (decompiler expanded Unity's == operator)

3257878.summary: Decides whether evaluatedCard is a valid match for a TargetCriteria, relative to thisCard (the ability owner). It checks which side owns it, hero exclusions, card type, conditions, keywords, traits, stat filters, specific cards, enchantments and army. Returns true if every check passes.
comments: Closure holds the evaluated card for the adjacent-units search at the end
No criteria object: log an error
First handle special TargetsAffected modes that decide by identity rather than by filters
any: every card qualifies
self: matches only if the evaluated card is this card
target: matches only if the evaluated card is the chosen target card
Other modes: actingCard accepts anything
previousAbilityFiltered: card must be in the previous ability's target list, then continue to the filters
previousAbilityTargets: true only if the card is in the previous ability's targets
attacker or abilityOwner: card must be this card
targetIfMeetsCriteria: the evaluated card must differ from the chosen target card
excludeSimilarCards: reject cards that share the same raw card data as this card
Pick friendlyUnits or enemyUnits flag depending on whether the card is on the same side as thisCard
Allow this card itself only if includeSelf is set; excludeNotSelf rejects all other cards
excludeFriendlyHero: reject a friendly warlord (or equivalent)
excludeEnemyHero: reject an enemy warlord (or equivalent)
Remnants (dead-unit leftovers) are rejected unless includeRemnants is set
Card type must match the criteria
Spell type, condition, keyword and trait filters must all pass
Attack filter: compare the target's melee/ranged attack with this unit's attack
Current health filter (the alt value is the target's bastion value)
Energy cost filter
Rarity filter
Specific card list, excluded enchantments and army filters
adjacentToSelfIfMeetsCriteria: also require the card to be next to this unit
All checks passed: the card qualifies
Evaluated card was null: log a warning and fail
Mode 200 (referencedCardInThisCard): evaluated card must be in this card's referenced cards
Mode 0xc9: like above but the card must also be in play
Mode 0xeb: matches if the evaluated card's extra traits equal the player's talent card's extra traits (list compare is decompiler-expanded)
Any failed check ends up here and returns false

3268df0.summary: Compares a card stat against a filter number using a StatFilterOptions comparison (equal, at least, at most, versus this unit's attack, or versus an alternate value such as bastion). Returns true when the comparison holds, or when the option is unknown.
comments: Group of simple options: equal, equal-or-higher and the lower/attack comparisons
EqualTo: stat equals filter
EqualOrHigher: stat >= filter (signed compare expanded by the decompiler)
EqualOrLowerToThisUnitAttack: stat <= this unit's attack
HigherToThisUnitAttack: stat > this unit's attack
Alt-value options: compare altValue (not the stat) against the filter
EqualToAlt: altValue == filter
EqualOrHigherAlt: altValue >= filter
EqualOrLowerAlt: altValue <= filter
EqualOrLowerIncludingBastion: add altValue to stat first, then compare as <= filter
LowerToThisUnitAttack: stat < this unit's attack
Shared <= filter comparison (EqualOrLower and the cases that jump here)

326815c.summary: Checks whether a card satisfies a UnitConditions filter (damaged, flying, can attack, has armour, quest states, died this turn and so on), flipped when excludeTrait is set. Logs an error for unhandled conditions.
comments: Big if-tree over the UnitConditions enum; each leaf computes a bool, then the exclude flag is applied at the end
protectedFromAttackDamage: protected from damage, or has bastion higher than the attacker's attack
protectedFromDamageOrSurvivor: delegates to the card's own check
hasAbility: card has an active ability
flying: has unstoppable, and is not vanguard (decompiler spread this over several jumps)
protectedFromDamage: true if the card has any of three protective traits (list built from trait ids 0xf0, 0x136, 0xe6)
mightAttack: the card's mightAct flag
damaged: has damage that pending healing will not fully cover
none passes; canAttack reads the card's canAct (anti-cheat ObscuredBool)
0xdc/0xdd/0xde: dies from pending damage, died this turn, died since last turn
stealthAndNotDealtKillDmg: has stealth and pending damage is not lethal
hasArmour: current armour value above zero (ObscuredInt)
hasAttackValues: melee attack or ranged attack greater than 0
costEqualToAvailableEnergy: card cost equals the owner's unused Energy
isWarlordEquivalent: card is a warlord or warlord-like unit
hasQuests: card has at least one quest
hasSecretOrder: card has secret orders
hasUseSpiritStone: card has an ability of type 600
hasUseFaith: card has an ability of type 0x25d
isPraying: the card's praying flag
isWarlordOrVehicle / isBattlesuitOrVehicle: warlord or Battlesuit keyword, else falls back to a Vehicle keyword (id 10)
isInfrantryOrBeast: Infantry keyword, else a second keyword (id 0x23)
siege: ability requires loading
hasQuestCompleted: card has completed a quest (logged)
stealthOrWardOrDuplicitous: any of three traits (0x46, 0x8c, then 0xa0)
stealthOrCamouflage: stealth (0x46) or trait 0x3d9
onlyRemnants: card is a leaving-free remnant of a Necron unit
canUseDuty: the active ability has not been used yet
summonSickness: the card still has summoning sickness
Unknown condition: log an error
Apply the exclude flag: with exclude set the result is inverted
UnitConditions.none path: a trap armed but in deck is ignored (false); otherwise passes
Null card reference

comments: any = card has the requested trait
any2 = card has a trait flagged by a cached lambda (appears to be a blocking trait such as untargetable)
If it has no blocking trait, or the filter is summonRift: result = (filter none) or (has trait XOR exclude)
Has a blocking trait and filter is not summonRift: fails
